_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Notification of Critical Non-Conformance Report
summary: Provides format for immediately notifying the Program Manager of a critical non-conformance found anywhere in the production process, relaying information to the contracting activity about unmet requirements that could result in an unsafe condition.
use_relationship:
Is used to immediately notify the Program Manager that a critical non-conformance is found anywhere in the production process. This report relays the pertinent information to the contracting activity where requirements have not been met that could potentially result in an unsafe condition.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Notification of Critical Non-conformance Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Notification of Critical Non-conformance Report shall contain:

children.title: Prime Contractor name and contact number
Description of Event
children.content: (Provide a brief description of the non-conformance event that occurred).

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirements
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall be in Adobe electronic Portable Document Format (pdf), version 2007-2010.
